test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following does NOT figure among the themes of 'Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav'?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Health@75**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav** is an initiative of the Government of India to celebrate and commemorate 75 years of India’s independence.
 
• The themes of the celebration are broadly categorized under **Ideas@75, Resolve@75, Actions@75, and Achievements@75**.
 
• The theme **Health@75** does not figure among the official themes of Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav.
 
• The focus of the celebration is on **honoring the freedom fighters, showcasing the achievements of the nation, and fostering unity and resolve for future development.**
 
• The themes aim to inspire citizens and highlight areas such as **innovation, progress, and collective action.**
 
• While health is an important domain for national progress, it is not specifically designated as a theme under the framework of Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav.
 
• The initiative emphasizes collective participation across various sectors like culture, governance, and economy to celebrate India’s journey and future aspirations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ideas@75**__

 __
 
• **Ideas@75** focuses on innovative ideas and initiatives that will shape the future of India.
 
• This theme emphasizes **creativity, cultural heritage, and intellectual contributions** to the nation's progress.
 
 
 
• **Actions@75**__
 __
 
• **Actions@75** highlights the collective efforts and practical steps being taken to achieve national goals.
 
• This theme includes activities and programs that reflect **development, governance, and community engagement.**
 
 
 
• **Resolve@75**__
 
 
• **Resolve@75** focuses on the determination and commitment of citizens to build a better future for the country.
 
• This theme emphasizes **unity, resilience, and the vision for India’s development.**
